attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: article_category_matching_from_excel

steps:
  - id: read_category_spreadsheet
    op: google_drive/read_spreadsheet
    params:
      file_name: category_mapping
      sheet: Sheet1
    output: category_rows

  - id: extract_article_title
    op: data/extract_field
    params:
      source: extracted_article_data
      field: title
    output: article_title

  - id: normalise_article_title
    op: text/normalise
    params:
      input: "{{ article_title }}"
      remove_accents: true
      lowercase: true
      strip_non_alphanumeric: true
    output: normalised_article_title

  - id: normalise_spreadsheet_titles
    op: text/normalise_batch
    params:
      input: "{{ category_rows }}"
      field: title
      remove_accents: true
      lowercase: true
      strip_non_alphanumeric: true
    output: normalised_category_rows

  - id: fuzzy_match_category
    op: matching/fuzzy_lookup
    params:
      query: "{{ normalised_article_title }}"
      candidates: "{{ normalised_category_rows }}"
      match_field: normalised_title
      accent_insensitive: true
      punctuation_insensitive: true
    output: match_result

  - id: apply_matched_category
    op: conditional/if_then_else
    params:
      condition: "{{ match_result.found == true }}"
      if_true:
        op: data/set_fields
        params:
          source: extracted_article_data
          fields:
            category: "{{ match_result.row.category }}"
            section: "{{ match_result.row.section }}"
            needs_review: false
        output: categorised_article
      if_false:
        op: data/set_fields
        params:
          source: extracted_article_data
          fields:
            category: "Ciencia economica"
            section: "Dossier"
            needs_review: true
            review_reason: "No matching category found in spreadsheet for title"
        output: categorised_article
    output: categorised_article
